text:
SparkFlux Labs is a tight-knit product startup building developer tools that make testing fast, reliable and delightful. We move quickly, care about quality, and need a pragmatic Test Engineer to own automation for core features and CI pipelines.

What you'll do
- Design, implement and maintain automated UI and integration test suites using Selenium.
- Integrate and debug test runs in our CI system using Jenkins; own flaky test mitigation and reporting.
- Collaborate with engineers and product to translate acceptance criteria into robust automated tests.
- Triage failures, work with devs to reproduce and resolve issues, and ensure release quality gates are met.
- Improve test reliability, execution speed and coverage; add monitoring and alerts for test infrastructure.

What we need
- 2-5 years experience.
- Hands-on experience with Selenium.
- Hands-on experience with Jenkins.
- Strong problem-solving and debugging skills; ability to write clear bug reports and test plans.
- Familiarity with REST APIs and experience validating backend behavior from tests.

Bonus points (preferred/good-to-have)
- Playwright
- Postman
- Test Automation
- Java

Location and work mode
Hybrid: Delhi NCR, 3 days a week in the office.
